provenance: New preregistered portfolio authored from public TASK.md requirements before either selector arm ran; not the historical smoke portfolio and not reconstructed from its summary.

hypothesis.hypothesis: Parse DN/PN integers with boundary-aware bilingual regexes and map material/joining aliases to canonical values before filtering the catalog.
hypothesis.rationale: The public task defines a finite set of notation aliases and exact numeric requirements.
hypothesis.expected_effect: Increase exact matches while keeping incomplete and unsupported queries abstained.
hypothesis.falsification_condition: DEV quality does not improve or a partial/ambiguous query returns an article.

candidates.suspected_failure_mode: Substring regexes may accept malformed or adjacent numeric tokens.
candidates.predicted_observable: Exact alias and integer recognition with abstention when any attribute is missing.
candidates.discriminating_test: Run the frozen public DEV cases covering English/Russian aliases, exact DN/PN mismatches, missing attributes, and unknown combinations.
candidates.rationale: Use explicit token boundaries and canonical attribute values, then require a unique exact catalog tuple.
candidates.uncertainty: No experiment evidence; extraction and boundary behavior remain to be measured.

hypothesis.hypothesis: Normalize Russian and English unit/material/joining aliases into canonical tokens, extract one value per attribute, and abstain on duplicate or conflicting mentions.
hypothesis.rationale: A normalization stage can reduce language-specific branching while preserving exact attribute constraints.
hypothesis.expected_effect: Improve bilingual coverage without accepting conflicting or incomplete descriptions.
hypothesis.falsification_condition: Normalization conflates distinct attributes or fails to improve the frozen DEV quality.

candidates.suspected_failure_mode: Substring-based alias replacement may collide with unrelated words or hide conflicts.
candidates.predicted_observable: Canonical attribute extraction is stable across documented Russian and English synonyms.
candidates.discriminating_test: Compare normalized attribute extraction on all frozen public DEV cases, including absent and conflicting values.
candidates.rationale: Build a small explicit alias map and validate extracted value cardinality before exact tuple lookup.
candidates.uncertainty: The public task lists aliases but does not specify tokenizer details.

hypothesis.hypothesis: Extract possible values for each of the four attributes independently, intersect those constraints with catalog rows, and return only a unique surviving article.
hypothesis.rationale: Independent constraints make missing, unsupported, and conflicting attributes visible before selection.
hypothesis.expected_effect: Preserve no-match safety while matching supported exact catalog tuples.
hypothesis.falsification_condition: The intersection accepts a row without explicit evidence for all four attributes or abstains on valid complete queries.

candidates.suspected_failure_mode: A permissive extractor may produce multiple possible values and create accidental matches.
candidates.predicted_observable: Every returned article satisfies four independently extracted exact constraints and uniqueness.
candidates.discriminating_test: Run frozen public cases for missing attributes, wrong attribute combinations, unknown catalog tuples, and valid exact matches.
candidates.rationale: Use canonical value sets per attribute and require exactly one catalog row in their intersection.
candidates.uncertainty: No experiment evidence; parser ambiguity and overlap require measurement.
